verdict.rationale: Pipecat's production telephony docs describe inbound calls arriving from your own carrier (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, or your SIP provider) via your webhook, and the site lists SIP and PSTN as transports, so you bring your own carrier rather than using bundled telephony. However, connecting a PBX or SIP trunk directly is only mentioned in passing, with no setup docs. missing for 10: documented SIP trunk/PBX configuration steps, explicit guidance on bringing existing Twilio/Telnyx numbers, independent or hands-on corroboration of carrier/SIP integration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can connect my own carrier or PBX via SIP trunking (or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers) instead of being locked to bundled telephony

citations.quote: the carrier (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, or your SIP provider) is calling your webhook to tell you there's an inbound call
